review.assessment: This change introduces `pubslug/slugs.py`, implementing slug generation by lowercasing titles, replacing non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, collapsing double hyphens, and truncating to a hard limit of 20 characters. The `assign` function iterates through the article list and applies this transformation independently to each title without any deduplication or collision-resolution logic. Consequently, articles sharing an identical prefix after truncation will be assigned duplicate URLs, directly contradicting the task requirement that newsletter links must not overwrite one another.

findings.call: assign([{'id': 'a1', 'title': 'How to build a resilient ingest pipeline'}, {'id': 'a2', 'title': 'How to build a resilient queue consumer'}])
findings.defect: Missing slug collision resolution: `assign` processes articles in isolation. When truncated title prefixes match, no disambiguation suffix or index is appended, resulting in identical URLs that will overwrite each other in the catalogue.
